title: The rikma's shared information
intro: One place for the documents, images and links the rikma works with. Every member can see them, and every member can add.
loadFailed: We couldn't load the shelf just now. You can still add an item, and the list will catch up.
empty: The shelf is still empty. The first item — a contract, a photo, a link to your Drive — starts it off.
vaultNote: Passwords and secrets are not kept here. A secret in a text field is a secret the server can read — the encrypted vault comes as a separate step.

drive.title: The rikma's Drive
drive.note: The link already set in the rikma's details

add.urlHint: A link to a Drive, a doc or any site. The file stays where it is — only the link is stored here.
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: How the item shows in the list. Left empty, it takes the file's name.
add.folderHint: Groups similar items together. Pick an existing folder or type a new one.
add.notePlaceholder: What it is and why it matters to the rikma (optional)
add.choose: Choose a file — or drop it here
add.fileHintMax: Up to {{max}}. Documents, spreadsheets, slides, images, PDF, text and zip.
add.privateHint: Kept in private storage — only the rikma’s members can open it

row.removeConfirm: Take “{{name}}” off the shelf? It leaves the list and is not deleted for good.

p2p.title: Sharing between partners
p2p.lead: When this device joins, files on the shelf can come straight from another partner’s device in the rikma — without passing through the server. It is a pilot that measures whether this works for us.
p2p.statusAlone: Connected — no partners available right now

status.offline: Not connected right now — files open from the server

p2p.clear: Delete the files from this device
p2p.clearConfirm: Delete the files stored on this device? They stay on the shelf.
p2p.termIp: Partners in the rikma who receive a file from you can see this device’s public IP address.
p2p.termBandwidth: The device uses some of your bandwidth to pass files to partners, only while this tab is open — at most two transfers at once.
p2p.termVerify: Every file from a partner is checked against the fingerprint recorded at upload. A file that does not match is discarded and opened from the server instead.
p2p.termMeasure: Only statistics are kept — where a file came from and how long it took. Not the file name, and not who opened it.

vault.title: The rikma's vault
vault.honest: End-to-end encrypted: the server stores only ciphertext. Someone who leaves the rikma still knows what they already saw, so after someone leaves, a list of passwords to change appears here.
vault.offDesc: This rikma's vault isn't on yet. Once it is, every member can store and read shared passwords and secrets.
vault.locked: The vault exists, but its key hasn't been shared with this device yet. That happens automatically the next time another member opens the vault.
vault.error: Something went wrong in the vault: {{reason}}
vault.exposedDesc: These secrets were visible to them and haven't been changed since. Change them at the service itself, then update them here:
vault.name: Name
vault.empty: No secrets in the vault yet.
vault.copyFailed: Copy failed. Show the password and copy it by hand.
vault.removeConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" from the vault? No member will see it anymore.
